text: Crimthann Mór mac Fidaigh is counted among the recorded kings of Tara. His sister Mongfhinn had a nature beyond the human. His daughter Eithne Úathach was a woman who ate others. These relatives place him where myth and history run together.

okr.objective: Crimthann Mór mac Fidaigh was a recorded king of Tara whose relatives mark him as supernatural.
key_results: He was recorded as a historical king of Tara.
